#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

#define LL long long int
#define ULL unsigned LL
#define PII pair<int, int>
#define PB push_back
#define MP make_pair
#define INF 1000000000
#define MOD 1000000007

int shortest[15][15][15][15];
int cap[400][400];
char scien[20][20];
char reac[20][20];
int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0};
int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
int iter = 3;
int vis[400];

int n, t;
int aug(int cnode, int dest, int bneck) {
    if (cnode == dest) {
        return bneck;
    }
    if (vis[cnode] == iter) {
        return 0;
    }
    vis[cnode] = iter;
    for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
        int cret = 0;
        if (cap[cnode][i] > 0 && (cret = aug(i, dest, min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]))) > 0) {
            // cout << cnode << " ";
            cap[cnode][i] -= cret;
            cap[i][cnode] += cret;
            return cret;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int getnode(int x, int y) {
    return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
}
int reach[13][13];
int treach[13][13];
void expand(int val) {
    int i, j, k;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                for (k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        reach[ni][nj] = val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
bool canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
    memset(reach, 0, sizeof(reach));
    reach[sx][sy] = 1;
    reach[ix][iy] = 2;
    int iters = 100;
    while (iters--) {
        expand(1);
        if (reach[tx][ty] == 1)
            return true;
        expand(2);
        if (reach[tx][ty] == 2)
            return false; 
    }
    return false;
}
int main() {
    int infx, infy;
    memset(shortest, 1, sizeof(shortest));
    cin >> n >> t;
    int i, j;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> scien[i] + 1;
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                infx = i;
                infy = j;
            }
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> reac[i] + 1;
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ni = i + dx[k];
                int nj = j + dy[k];
                if (ni <= n && ni > 0 && nj <= n && nj > 0) {
                    if (scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y')
                        shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ki, kj, ii, ij, ji, jj;
    for (ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
        for (kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
            for (ii = 1; ii <= n; ii++) {
                for (ij = 1; ij <= n; ij++) {
                    for (ji = 1; ji <= n; ji++) {
                        for (jj = 1; jj <= n; jj++) {
                            shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj] = min(
                                    shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj], 
                                    shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj]
                                    );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int src = n * n * 2 + 1;
    int dest = n * n * 2 + 2;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (isdigit(scien[i][j])) {
                cin >> cap[src][getnode(i, j)];
            }
            if (isdigit(reac[i][j])) {
                cin >> cap[n * n + getnode(i, j)][dest];
            }

            if (isdigit(scien[i][j])) {
                for (ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
                    for (kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                        if (scien[i][j] > '0' && reac[ki][kj] > '0') {
                            if (isdigit(reac[ki][kj]) && shortest[i][j][ki][kj] <= t && canreach(i, j, ki, kj, infx, infy)) {
                                // printf("(%d, %d) can reach (%d, %d)\n", i, j, ki, kj);
                                cap[getnode(i, j)][n * n + getnode(ki, kj)] = 1000;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int mflow = 0, ret;
    while ((ret = aug(src, dest, 1000))) {
        // cout << endl;
        mflow += ret;
        iter ++;
    }
    cout << mflow << endl;
    return 0;
}
